newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 30.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 30.

text.p: * NationsBank Corp said it had agreed to acquire Boatmen's Bancshares Inc in an exchange of 0.6525 NationsBank share for each share of Boatmen's, or about $60 per Boatmen's share, based on NationsBank's closing price on Thursday of 92-3/8. Boatmen's closed at 42-15/16.
* PepsiCo said weakness at its Taco Bell and Pizza Hut units could hurt profits, according to the Wall Street Journal. Pepsi closed off 1-3/8 to 28-5/8.
* Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing, at a presentation to analysts late Thursday, said it could earn $3.55 to $3.60 a share in 1996. It closed at 67-3/8, off 1/8.
* ValuJet Inc won tentative approval from U.S. aviation authorities to resume operations. It closed at 11, up 1/2.
* Neiman Marcus Group Inc posted higher fourth quarter net income after the bell on Thursday. It closed up 1/4 at 28-3/8.
* Sierra Semiconductor Corp shares extended yesterday's gains into after-hours trading after the company said it plans to sell its modem chipset business.
